🎯 𝗨𝗦𝗘 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗘: To create structured, referenceable knowledge bases from technical books and documents that can be directly utilized by AI agents during work or study.
📅 Created: May 2026 • Updated: Oct 2026

⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆⋆

✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

✅ Converts technical books and documents into agent skills
✅ Supports multiple input formats (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, MOBI)
✅ Enables on-demand loading of skills by AI agents
✅ Reduces token usage compared to direct context inclusion
✅ Integrates with AI agents like GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, Claude Code, Hermes Agent, OpenCode, and OpenClaw
✅ Structures content into frameworks, decision rules, anti-patterns, and per-chapter files

Book-to-skill is a Python tool that transforms technical books and documents into structured agent skills. It enables AI agents to efficiently reference and utilize the information from these sources, overcoming the limitations of traditional PDF searching or direct context dumping.

Gridex is a cross-platform database IDE for macOS, Windows, and Linux, supporting a wide range of databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, SQL Server, and ClickHouse. It offers a unified interface for managing these databases, featuring a built-in MCP server and AI chat capabilities.
